{{Top|leg}}
'''Nadri''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Nadri once witnessed a blaster duel between an experienced gunman and rookie; the gunman believed the rookie would use the [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]] on his hip, but the rookie instead spun and drew a [[micro blaster]] from a wrist holster.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
